content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** GOVLAW — **deviation** (targeted at fallback).

- **Governing law (fallback element 1): already met.** § 13.6.1 (p0652) selects the laws of the State of Delaware, an accepted jurisdiction, so we did not touch it or upgrade it to New York.
- **Dispute forum (fallback element 2): failed.** § 13.7.1 (p0655) routes any unresolved Dispute to mandatory arbitration under § 13.7.3 (p0657) and Schedule 13.7.3, whose procedures — including the seat — are redacted. No accepted court forum is designated anywhere, and § 13.6.2's service clause dangles on "any such court" with no jurisdiction provision behind it.
- **Cure (2 surgical replacements, minimality gate ok:true):** the arbitration election in § 13.7.1 becomes submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Delaware state and federal courts, and § 13.7.3 is conformed so the retained arbitration machinery and Schedule 13.7.3 do not contradict that forum.
- **Left intact:** the Delaware choice-of-law sentence, the Senior Officer escalation, the § 13.7.2 patent validity/inventorship carve-out, and the § 13.11 equitable-relief carve-out (customary and not fatal to an exclusive merits forum).
